column1: # Options shown in the simple view of a screensaver's settings; everything else folds into Advanced.
# Columns (tab separated): hack id (with or without _gles3), comma separated option names (at most 8,
# all present in options/<hack>.tsv). A hack not listed shows its basic-level options (preset, seed,
# palette, style, speed). Black Hole has its own simple mode (blackhole-simple.tsv).
